svg.title: Dennis Joseph, Python full-stack developer
svg.desc: Profile of Dennis Joseph: seven projects (Skyrict, ITC Global Enterprise, Zignature, PyDocAI, DENJO-C, Biloft, Wedding Invitation), technology stack, experience at Bridgeon Solutions and freelance, education and contact details.
svg.text: Kozhikode, Kerala. Freelance since 2024, Software Developer at Bridgeon Solutions since Aug 2025.
I build production Python systems: database, API, interface and deployment. REST APIs, background
workers and LLM features, shipped with Docker, AWS and CI/CD.
Multi-tenant AI-native ERP, team of 4. I own the Finance & Accounting module: a double-entry ledger,
four report engines (trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, AR aging) and a pgvector RAG assistant that
B2B website for a Canadian industrial supplier: a product catalogue and a serverless quote-request
flow that delivers enquiries to the client's inbox with no backend server to maintain.
Job agency platform: company and listing models, slug routing, filtering and OpenAPI docs on the
API, with a React frontend using Google sign-in and JWT sessions.
Documentation platform with queued generation jobs, provider fallback when a model rate-limits, and
Storefront and admin in one build: catalogue, cart, checkout, order management and role-based access
control on a secured REST API.
Billing and invoicing app for a local business: Django backend, React front end, pywebview shell,
packaged as a single-file installer the staff just double-click.
Invitation site for a family wedding: twelve rotating design themes, animated florals, confetti on
interactions and all the event details on one shareable page.
Python, Django, DRF, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Pydantic, Celery, Redis
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Vite
Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, LangGraph, RAG, RAGAS
AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront), Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel
Own the Finance & Accounting module of Skyrict. Built the double-entry ledger, four report engines and
Client work for ITC Global Enterprise (Canada), Zignature and Biloft, from database to deployment.
BVM Holy Cross College, MG University. English: C1 Advanced (EF SET).
Open to Python backend, full-stack and AI engineering roles, and to freelance projects.
